concerns.text: The GLUE dataset URLs cited for both MNLI (wake‑phase) and QNLI (few‑shot evaluation) point to the same generic parquet file (https://huggingface.co/datasets/nyu-mll/glue/resolve/main/ax/test-00000-of-00001.parquet), which is the AX test split, not the MNLI training split nor the QNLI validation split. This mis‑cites the actual data used and could lead to training/evaluation on the wrong split, violating the requirement that the cited dataset matches the intended task.

The plan schedules 5 random seeds × 4 temperature values for the wake/dream regime (20 runs) plus 5 baseline runs, each with 100 gradient steps. Running all 25 experiments sequentially on a single GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ≤7 GB RAM) is unlikely to finish within the 5‑hour wall‑clock limit imposed by the constitution. This exceeds the feasible compute budget and thus the experiment cannot be executed as described.
